title: Jazzy American Keto Rice Bowl
description: A keto-friendly take on a classic American dish, served in a bowl.

ingredients.name: Rice
ingredients.notes: Caution: not a keto staple, but used here for flavor

instructions: 2. In a bowl, mix together crushed jazzy, low-fat American cheese, and cooked rice.
3. Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl.
4. Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
